metadata.title: Strategy Stock Rises More Than Bitcoin as Coinbase, Robinhood Lag<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Strategy Didn’t Buy Bitcoin as Cryptos Surged, but It Wasn’t Sitting Still
Strategy didn’t buy any Bitcoin last week, but it’s still making the most of the recent cryptocurrency comeback.
